{{Quote|Hmmm... That's a ''Banking Clan shuttle'' down there. I wonder what ''they're'' here for?|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Foreclosure">{{TCWComicCite|6.7|Foreclosure}}</ref>}}
The '''Banking Clan shuttle''' was a small transport utilized by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Characteristics==
The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] appeared as a scaled-down design of the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in appearance, with horizontal wings and a stubby tailfin.

==History==
A pair of Clan representatives used a shuttle of this kind to visit the [[Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
